source_routes.source: Keio University Digital Collections: Digital Library of Yukichi Fukuzawa's Work
source_routes.inspection_notes: Bundled pypdf opened the PDFs, but text extraction is not usable as a clean reading body: most volumes return whitespace, and the first volume returns mojibake with Japanese encoding warnings.
Decoded Shift-JIS ruby text to UTF-8; readable text includes 初編 through 十七編 and bottom metadata for base text, parent text, inputter, corrector, and Aozora production.

proposed_admission.work_title: 学問のすすめ / Gakumon no susume
proposed_admission.edition_label: Aozora Bunko #47061 ruby text, Shift-JIS source decoded to UTF-8; base text: 日本の名著 33 福沢諭吉, Chuo Koronsha Chuko Backs, 1984; parent text: 福沢諭吉全集 第三巻, Iwanami Shoten, 1959; private-reading derivative, accessed 2026-08-23
proposed_admission.license_notes: Aozora/NDL metadata states copyright protection period expired; preserve Aozora input/correction attribution and production note for any outward boundary.
proposed_admission.coverage_notes: Complete Aozora text includes 初編 through 十七編; source-authority coverage remains selected works because civilization essays beyond Gakumon no susume remain absent.

not_recommended.reason: Current library body tooling expects text payloads; Keio PDFs are facsimile witnesses and need OCR or a facsimile-body schema before direct admission.
Useful for later reading support, but less aligned with original-era source preservation than the Japanese Aozora text plus Keio facsimile route.

reentry_point.next_action: admit Aozora decoded UTF-8 text as the Fukuzawa body candidate
reentry_point.expected_effect_if_authorized: LIB-INDUSTRIAL-AUTHORITY-051-FUKUZAWA becomes available; Rachel Carson remains the only missing Industrial authority.
